patterns.skill_gap: In-client rendering of the new warrior toggles, the reset button's visible move, and pips design-mode drop/reset stays UNCONFIRMED — the suite pins trees and call shapes, not pixels.
patterns.what_was_hard: Nothing structural: the hud_show_tf precedent dictated the toggle shape exactly, the update_result_font guard dictated the reset seam, and the pips probe had a clean no-consumer answer. The only friction was a CRLF comment-block edit needing a narrower match.
patterns.what_worked: Reading hud.lua/bars.lua read-only first made each verdict mechanical: hide-on-false shape copied exactly, reset routed through the existing applier instead of re-anchoring inline, pips left unwired with absence pins plus a caller-side spec rather than options without a consumer.
